name: Generali Malaga Marathon
summary: A fast, flat marathon through central Malaga, its eastern seafront neighborhoods, La Rosaleda, and the western coast, starting and finishing on Paseo del Parque.
heroNote: Great cheering spots include Alameda Principal near the early city loop, the Pedregalejo and El Palo seafront, La Rosaleda, and the final coastal stretch back toward Paseo del Parque.
specialNote: This race uses staggered wave starts after the 08:30 first gun. Check your runner's assigned start time.
